description: Find listed estate planning firms by place (location text, state, metro, or lat/lng with a radius), service, whether the first step can be completed online, and whether the firm publishes a price. Results include each firm's profile URL and the source of every fact. Place searches list labeled sponsored placements first. Name-only nationwide lookup is alphabetical, not ranked.

lat.description: Latitude, with lng: search around a point instead of a named place.

location.description: City and state ("Portland, OR"), a state ("Oregon" or "OR"), or a 5-digit ZIP code. Maui and Hawaii island aliases use disclosed reference points and the requested radius, not island boundaries. For search_firms, omit place only with a nonempty name; summarize_place may omit place for nationwide facts.

metro.description: Metro slug from list_places, e.g. portland-or. An alternative to location.

name.description: Part of the firm name. Name-only lookup works without a place and sorts alphabetically. A trailing state, e.g. Sterling Hawaii, is parsed only if the literal name has no match; explicit geography is not overridden.

offset.description: Public results to skip, for paging (maximum 40).

online.description: Only firms with online intake for the requested service. General estate planning excludes package-specific routes; contact and scheduling forms do not count. Read online_start for scope.

priced.description: Only firms that publish a price.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles around a city, ZIP, metro or point (1–250, default 50). Ignored for states.

service.description: Narrow to firms that list this service on their website (see list_services).

state.description: State code or slug, e.g. OR or oregon. An alternative to location.

name: search_firms
title: Search estate planning firms
